jobs.title: Program Manager | Enterprise Architecture & Governance
jobs.description:
Job Title: Program Manager

Full Time Opportunity | Enterprise Architecture Strategy & Governance | EA Program & Governance Operations

General Description

We are looking for a Program Manager under Enterprise Architecture Strategy & Governance to support the effective execution of the Enterprise Architecture program. The role coordinates technology governance operations, facilitates cross-functional collaboration, supports reporting and practice visibility, and ensures governance activities are executed efficiently and consistently across the organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

- Coordinate Enterprise Architecture program planning activities, objectives, and progress tracking across program workstreams and participating teams.

- Monitor program risks, dependencies, commitments, and action items requiring leadership visibility.

- Coordinate recurring forums and other division-wide operational activities to support alignment across workstreams, including agendas, action items, and follow-up.

- Consolidate program metrics, accomplishments, and highlights for leadership reporting and practice visibility.

- Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, summaries, and communications.

- Maintain the governance work plan, priorities, backlog, schedules, dependencies, and status across governance initiatives.

- Track governance document development, review and approval activities.

- Coordinate publication, communications, adoption and lifecycle management activities for governance documents.

- Maintain Enterprise Architecture repositories, collaboration platforms, and practice information, including SharePoint content and governance documentation.

- Coordinate responses to audit, regulatory, compliance, and governance-related information requests.

Education

Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

- Minimum 5 years of combined experience in program management, project management, governance operations, business operations, process management, or a related function.

- Excellent oral and written communication skills in Spanish and English.Strong planning, organization, facilitation, prioritization, and follow-up skills.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional work, dependencies, approvals, publication activities, and multiple concurrent priorities.

- Experience maintaining work plans, backlogs, schedules, repositories, metrics, dashboards, and executive-ready reporting.

- Ability to identify blockers, escalate issues appropriately, and drive timely follow-through without direct authority.

- Proficient with Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint; experience with workflow, ticketing, reporting, or collaboration tools is preferred.

- Experience in financial services, technology governance, architecture governance, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, or audit support is a plus.

- Program or project management certification is a plus.

Important: The candidate must provide evidence of academic preparation or courses related to the job posting, if necessary.

Our hybrid work model benefit applies to certain positions and is subject to changes based on the organizational needs.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States.  This position is not open to applicants who need visa sponsorship or transfer of visa sponsorship at this time.

ABOUT US

Popular is Puerto Rico’s leading financial institution and have been evolving since it was founded over a century ago. From a small bank it has developed into a large corporation that offer a wide variety of services and financial solutions to our customers, with presence in the United States, the Caribbean and Latin America.

As employees, we are dedicated to making our customers dreams come true by offering financial solutions in each stage of their life. Our extensive trajectory demonstrates the resiliency and determination of our employees to innovate, reach for the right solutions and strongly support the communities we serve; therefore, we value their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds.

We reaffirm our commitment to always offer essential financial services and solutions for our customers and communities, including during emergency situations and/or natural disasters. jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Job Type

General Description

Oversees compliance of established policies and procedures in accordance with banking laws, and regulations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Examines established policies, procedures, and practices to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.  Stays abreast of changes to banking laws, and regulations affecting the management, operations, and product offerings. Coordinates with legal counsel and operating and compliance departments to ensure adherence to laws and regulations related to new or revised products and services offerings.  Oversees the revision, preparation, and dissemination of new and updated compliance standards and procedures.  Coordinates, supervises, and supports compliance-related programs, such as compliance training, compliance testing and reporting, disaster recovery, and contingency planning. Manages and analyzes cases of potentially suspicious activity from the automated monitoring system. Interacts with branch personnel regarding unusual activity or customer due diligence to determine if an appropriate resolution can be reached. Arranges compliance audits and communicate audit results and recommendations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Education

Bachelor's degree in law, business administration, finance or related fields.

Experience

At least three to five years related experience in compliance, preferably in banking industry.

Certifications

Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Other Qualifications

-

- Strong knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering (AML)/ , Know Your Customer (KYC), and financial crime prevention regulations.

- Ability to identify compliance risks, recommend corrective actions, and implement effective controls.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with regulators, senior management, and employees.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.

- Ability to prepare and deliver presentations, training sessions, and compliance-related reports.

- Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, make informed decisions, and take ownership of compliance-related responsibilities.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

- Demonstrated leadership, accountability, and ownership in managing compliance responsibilities.

- Ability to build strong working relationships across business units and foster a culture of compliance.

- Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet regulatory deadlines.

- Ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and integrity.

- Self-motivated, proactive, and committed to staying current on regulatory changes and industry best practices.

- Fluent in English; bilingual proficiency is considered an asset.

- Willingness to obtain or maintain relevant compliance certifications and regulatory approvals as required by the British Virgin Islands regulatory authorities.

Preferred Qualifications

- Professional certifications such as CAMS, CFCS, CRCM, CIA or equivalent.

- Previous experience working with financial institutions, banking regulations, or regulatory agencies.

- Experience serving as a liaison with regulatory authorities and supporting regulatory examinations.

Region Locations

Tortola, British Virgin Islands (BVI)

3. Succeed Together
2. Own Every Moment
4. Build the Future

jobs.title: Seasonal HR Associate | Learning & Development
jobs.description:
Job Title: Seasonal HR Associate | Learning & Development

Full Time Opportunity

General Description

The Human Resources Associate role in the Learning and Development department is responsible of coordinating all training logistics associated with the corporate learning offerings and support technology training design.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

- Coordinate with external and internal resources/facilitators all the scheduling for the assigned learning activities.

- Responsible of all electronic training attendance record keeping following established guidelines using our LMS (Success Factors).

- Plan, prepare and monitor the production of all training materials for each session.

- Ensure that all training session requirements are met according to course design and specifications (room setup, necessary materials, and facility conditions, among others).

- Provide support to on-site facilitators to guarantee that the learning experience occurs as designed.

- Administer test scores, maintain records, and communicate results of the different course modules as defined by internal processes and guidelines.

- Administer and maintain records of course satisfaction survey results for each session.

- Proactively identify and communicate to the Specialist any issues, observations, or opportunities for improvement identified during training sessions.

- Prepare reports and presentations related to assigned learning projects.

- Perform other responsibilities, including managing invoices and program budget, updating training materials and generating learning activities reports.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or Arts, from a recognized and accredited college, with a concentration on Human Resources, Labor Relations, Psychology or related.

Experience

A minimum of two (2) years of experience in coordination or human resources functions.

Other Qualifications

- Project Management: Ability to work under pressure with minimum supervision.  Capacity to achieve results according to plan ensuring the expected quality. Excellent organization capacity to define priorities, work with multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and flexible to change.  Knowledge of project coordination, identification of business needs, work plan, budget control, time management, resource allocation, and status reports.  Must demonstrate leadership, logic, and reasoning skills.

- Operational/Regulations Processes: Knowledge of resources allocation, organization’s policies, and regulations.  Ability to establish, conduct and track operational processes properly, and implement changes.

- Excellent customer service, task coordination and problem-solving skills.

- Self-directed with demonstrated high levels of productivity and structure.

- Able to multi-task many projects simultaneously, with minimal supervision, with a positive attitude ensuring attention to detail, and accuracy within the required timeframe.

- Excellent interpersonal and teamwork/partnering skills with both internal and external colleagues.

- Excellent oral and written communications in both Spanish and English.

- Computer and technological skills: Intermediate or advanced proficiency of MS Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint & Excel) ZAP y SAP/ERP, among others.  Success Factors knowledge is a plus.

Important: The candidate must provide evidence of academic preparation or courses related to the job posting, if necessary.
